policy.selection_semantics: heuristic expected-information-gain proxy; not measured information gain

experiments.title: Cross-polymer + real-matrix head-to-head
experiments.objective: Test whether apparent removal advantages survive changes in polymer chemistry and water matrix.
readouts: removal fraction for PS, PET and PE
performance shift between controlled water and real wastewater/natural-water matrix
rank-order stability across polymers and matrices
kill_criteria: replicates fail to reproduce the effect direction

experiments.title: Magnetic recovery + secondary-release mass balance
experiments.objective: Measure whether removal is offset by unrecovered sorbent, coating, metal or particle release.
readouts: microplastic removal after accounting for unrecovered sorbent
kill_criteria: material loss exceeds the pre-registered tolerance
secondary release negates the remediation advantage
recovery is not reproducible across independent runs

experiments.title: Ten-cycle capture/recovery/regeneration challenge
experiments.objective: Resolve whether high single-run performance survives repeated use.
controls: fresh-material control at matched cycle checkpoints
kill_criteria: material performance falls below the pre-registered retention threshold
magnetic recovery deteriorates materially across cycles

experiments.title: Matched ecotoxicity + leachate screen
experiments.objective: Test whether candidate materials or their post-use leachates create a biological hazard signal.
readouts: matched organism/cell viability or growth endpoint appropriate to the environmental matrix
relationship between observed effect and measured material release
kill_criteria: candidate or leachate produces a reproducible adverse effect above the pre-registered threshold
post-use leachate is materially worse than matched controls

experiments.title: pH × matrix robustness map
experiments.objective: Determine whether the candidate ranking is stable across realistic operating-window perturbations.
readouts: interaction between pH and matrix complexity
kill_criteria: ranking reverses under modest operating-window changes
release risk rises sharply inside the intended operating window

experiments.title: Champion versus published-reference replay
experiments.objective: Test whether the top virtual candidate reproduces the published anchor before any optimization claim is considered.
readouts: difference between measured result and digital-twin baseline
kill_criteria: digital-twin baseline error exceeds the pre-registered tolerance
